name: Black Harde 100gm | boosts immunity, improve strength and provide nourishment to the scalp
original_description:
Aayurvedaa Black Harde is a premium, traditionally prepared fruit of the Terminalia chebula plant, carefully harvested and sun-dried to preserve its natural essence. In Ayurvedic practice, Harde has long been valued as a key ingredient in formulations supporting natural balance and holistic well-being.

Used for centuries in classical Ayurvedic texts, Black Harde is often incorporated into herbal preparations to support the body’s natural rhythms. It is known for its grounding qualities and is traditionally associated with digestive harmony and internal cleansing. Many practitioners include it in routines focused on maintaining a healthy gut environment and supporting the body’s natural processes of renewal.

Traditional Uses of Black Harde

  • Commonly used in Ayurvedic formulations to support digestive function
  • Traditionally blended into pastes for gentle internal cleansing
  • Valued in herbal traditions for its natural astringent and absorptive properties
  • Often included in scalp care blends as part of holistic hair and skin rituals

Each 100g pack contains 100% pure, organic Black Harde — no additives, no fillers, no preservatives. Ideal for those seeking authentic, time-honored herbal ingredients for home-based Ayurvedic routines.

Store in a cool, dry place. For external or internal use, consult with a qualified Ayurvedic practitioner to align with your individual constitution and lifestyle.

---
